notes: s015 is the second attributive article of ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐπιφέρων, whose head noun θεός is expressed and stands in front of it. Rule 31's test — τῷ θεῷ τῷ κτίσαντι → *God who created* — gives the supplied relativizer to the participle and leaves such an article `unrepresented`, and rule 90 disclaims in terms any unit in which a head noun is expressed. Rule 32's apposition clause reaches the same answer, θεός having already written the word the relative clause is predicated of. So *who* (t017) moves into ἐπιφέρων's unit and s015 becomes its own `unrepresented` unit. Nothing else in the verse changes.
